meta.model_name: Calibrated Logistic Regression on fresh crossings (PM2.5, pm25_lag1, pm25_rolling3, pm25_ratio_90)
meta.alert_definition: PM2.5-based category (PM2.5 > 90 µg/m3, CPCB 'Poor' band). Calibrated on fresh crossings (today's PM2.5 <= 90 µg/m³). Days with today's PM2.5 > 90 µg/m³ are labeled 'Already Poor'.
meta.threshold_split: Calibrated strictly on validation split 2018-07-01 to 2019-06-30 (NEVER tuned on test set)
meta.data_leakage_audit: Confirmed: exactly zero test rows (>= 2019-07-01) and zero test-derived statistics were used in training the model or in tuning/calibrating the alert thresholds. Thresholds were calibrated strictly on the validation split.

past_day_features: pm25_rolling3 (3-day backward rolling mean ending on day t: {t-2, t-1, t})
timing_audit.leakage_verification: Zero weather, fire, or air quality features use day t+1. All features are strictly aligned to observation time t or preceding days.

probability_calibration.derivation_explanation: Predicted probability of tomorrow's PM2.5 crossing into Poor AQI (>90 µg/m³) calibrated with Isotonic Regression on validation holdout. Rows where today's PM2.5 > 90 are flagged 'Already Poor' with null risk score.

persistence_tuned_fresh.calibrated_on: Validation split 2018-07-01 to 2019-06-30 (tuned to maximize fresh crossing F1 score)
persistence_tuned_fresh.description: Thresholded persistence baseline for fresh crossings from Moderate air today.

persistence_tuned_general.calibrated_on: Validation split 2018-07-01 to 2019-06-30 (tuned to maximize general alert F1 score)
persistence_tuned_general.description: Thresholded persistence baseline for all-row Poor or worse tomorrow.

general_alert_operating_point.calibrated_on: Validation split 2018-07-01 to 2019-06-30 across all rows
general_alert_operating_point.description: Threshold optimizing F1 on overall Poor or worse tomorrow target.

definitions.fire_100km: MODIS active fire detection within 100 km geodesic distance of station on the observation date.
definitions.upwind: Fire lies within a 90-degree angular quadrant (+/- 45 deg) of the direction the ERA5 daily 10m wind is blowing FROM (theta_from = (atan2(u10, v10) + 180) % 360).
definitions.top10_upwind_intensity: Variant A: 90th percentile of sum of upwind FRP (in MW) computed across positive upwind fire days in test period (denominator = 4,261 days, threshold >= 129.6 MW, n=447).
definitions.top10_upwind_intensity_all_rows: Variant B: 90th percentile of sum of upwind FRP (in MW) computed across ALL test rows (denominator = 33,855 rows, threshold >= 7.9 MW, n=3,387).

balanced.meaning: Optimizes F1 score balancing alert timeliness with false-alarm fatigue on validation data (2018-07-01 to 2019-06-30).

high_recall.meaning: Provides ~85-90% sensitivity for fresh crossing events on validation data, prioritizing public health warning over false alarms.

high_precision.meaning: Conservative threshold issuing alerts only when risk score of a fresh crossing exceeds 0.240 (highest precision with recall >= 50% on validation).
